ONE FLOW



Turn a rough idea into an interactive flow



Hi there,




Turn one proposed feature or internal-tool flow into something interactive for stakeholders to examine. Give Balsamiq AI a rough prompt or screenshot, then develop the wireframe into an interactive prototype without writing code.




Balsamiq is a wireframing and prototyping tool for taking ideas beyond static descriptions. The prototype gives reviewers something concrete to explore before the proposed flow becomes engineering work.




Use the 14-day trial to test one real flow and decide whether the result represents what you mean. No credit card is required.
